rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for domestic chores and housework.

example.english: Domesticity takes up my evenings after work.
example.traditional: 放工返到屋企，我仲要做家務。
example.jyutping: fong3 gung1 faan2 dou3 uk1 kei2 ngo5 zung6 jiu3 zou6 gaa1 mou6

rows.note: Use this for the general experience and routine of living at home, rather than the chores themselves.

example.english: After having children, I really started enjoying domesticity.
example.traditional: 有咗小朋友之後，我先真正享受到家庭生活。
example.jyutping: jau5 zo2 siu2 pang4 jau5 zi1 hau6 ngo5 sin1 zan1 zing3 hoeng2 sau6 dou3 gaa1 ting4 sang1 wut6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on emotional attachment to home and its comforts.

example.english: Their domesticity means they miss home after being away for a few days.
example.traditional: 他有濃厚的戀家情結，離家數日便會掛念家中一切。
example.jyutping: taa1 jau5 nung4 hau5 dik1 lyun2 gaa1 cing4 git3 lei4 gaa1 sou2 jat6 bin6 wui5 gwaa3 nim6 gaa1 zung1 jat1 cai3
